name: Honouliuli Preserve Fund: Resource Management and Community Engagement
summary: Small grants for Oahu organisations doing ecosystem restoration, invasive species and wildfire management, monitoring and community engagement at the Honouliuli Preserve. The 2025 round has closed.
reporting: Interim progress reports if the project runs longer than 12 months, and a final project and financial report.

eligibility.rule: Has 501(c)(3) status or applies with a fiscal sponsor

documents: IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter, unless previously applied or using a fiscal sponsor
Annual operating budget for current year
Income statement for most recently completed fiscal year
Balance sheet for most recently completed fiscal year
Local unit financial information, for local units of national organizations
Fiscal sponsor board resolution authorizing fiscal sponsorship

status.quote: Online Application Deadline: Friday, June 27, 2025, 4:00 p.m. HST

deadline.quote: Online Application Deadline: Friday, June 27, 2025, 4:00 p.m. HST

applicant_types.quote: This funding opportunity is open to non-profit and community-based organizations on O'ahu.

geography.quote: This funding opportunity is intended to support organizations on O'ahu

access.quote: This application is available for online submission through the Hawaiʻi Community Foundation's Grants Portal.

amount.quote: Grant requests for up to $15,000 USD will be considered.

fiscal_sponsor.quote: Applicants must be a non-profit organization with a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status. Organizations who do not have 501(c)(3) status may collaborate with a fiscal sponsor to apply for this funding opportunity.

reporting.quote: Grantee will be required to submit interim progress reports (if project is longer than 12 months) and a final project and financial report to HCF.

effort.quote: Online Application Deadline: Friday, June 27, 2025, 4:00 p.m. HST

eligibility.quote: Applicants must be a non-profit organization with a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status. Organizations who do not have 501(c)(3) status may collaborate with a fiscal sponsor to apply for this funding opportunity.
Grant requests for projects with a duration of 12-24 months (2 years maximum) will be considered.

after_award.quote: Grantee will be required to submit interim progress reports (if project is longer than 12 months) and a final project and financial report to HCF.

documents.quote: IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter (not required if previously applied to the Foundation or if applying through a fiscal sponsor) • Number of full-time, part-time, or regular volunteer staff • Organization Mission • Service Location(s) • Types of services provided (including age, gender, and target populations served) • Financial Statements o Annual Operating budget for current year

Income statement (or profit/loss statement) for the most recently completed fiscal year o Balance sheet for the most recently completed fiscal year o Audited financial statements are preferred but not required o Local units of national organizations must submit local unit financial information • Board of Directors List

Provide your total program budget, amount requested through this application, and upload a copy of your program's budget, showing income and expenses, indicating sources of income that are pending and secured.

Resolution by fiscal sponsor's board of directors authorizing fiscal sponsorship • Fiscal sponsor's agreement form Both forms can be found at: http://www.hawaiicommunityfoundation.org/grants/fiscalsponsor-materials • Fiscal sponsor's IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter
